items.title: Odesa deputy mayor reports sharp rise in attacks and air alerts
items.summary: First Deputy Mayor Oleksandr Filatov reportedly told the city executive committee that the intensity of attacks on Odesa in 2026 was nearly three times last year's level, while the number of air alerts had doubled.

items.title: Italy reportedly considering Eurofighter aircraft for Ukraine
items.summary: Italian newspaper La Repubblica reportedly said Italy could supply Ukraine with up to 20 Eurofighter jets. No finalized transfer was reported in the available account.

items.title: Fire reported at industrial building in Zaporizhzhia
items.summary: Local authorities reportedly said a strike on infrastructure caused a fire at a production building in Zaporizhzhia. Further details were not available in the report.
